newsitem.title: USA: Amcore splits stock, raises dividend.
newsitem.headline: Amcore splits stock, raises dividend.

text.p: Amcore Financial Inc said Monday its board of directors approved a three-for-two stock split and increased its quarterly dividend by 12.5 percent to $0.18 per pre-split share.

The stock split will be issued to shareholders of record on September 5 and will be distributed on September 17. Shareholders will receive one new share of Amcore common stock for every two shares held.
The cash dividend will be paid to shareholders of record on September 5 and is payable September 12 on pre-split shares. The previously quarterly dividend was $0.16 a share.
"This is is a strong message we are sending to the investment community about the confidence we have in our company and our future growth strategies," Robert Meuleman, president, said in a statement.
Amcore is a financial services company with assets of more than $3.6 billion.
